rationale: Tandem OS owns relationship-owner authority. The explicit generic organizational principal is Tandem Team, and a tracked policy may assign that principal to every actionable relationship, Sales, or proposal case unless a later explicit assignment supersedes it. This is accountable work ownership only and grants no individual or minion authority to approve, send, mutate providers, activate follow-up, or perform another consequential action. Resolution must use the tracked assignment and its decision provenance; it must never infer ownership from createdBy, a duplicate pipeline entry, a sender, recent activity, or another convenient field.
source_task: Current owner instruction in Codex on 2026-08-26: ownership should be generic and reside with Tandem OS or the Tandem team.
